files.used_for: Partition Act No. 16 of 1951, 48-page image scan with no text layer. Not an amending Act devoted to this Ordinance: it is a general Act whose section 85(1), under the marginal note 'Amendment of other written law', repeals section 12 of the Registration of Documents Ordinance (Cap. 101). Section 85(2) amends the Stamp Ordinance and is nothing to do with this statute. Every other mention of the Ordinance in the Act is an operative cross-reference, chiefly registering a partition action as a lis pendens, not an amendment. No tree was built: parsing the whole Partition Act as a Registration of Documents amendment would misfile it.

Not an amending Act devoted to this Ordinance: it is a general Act whose section 51, under the marginal note 'Amendment of the First Schedule to Chapter 117', amends Part III of the First Schedule to the Registration of Documents Ordinance -- in item 1, paragraph (a), substituting the figures '2.0' for '1.0', and in item 3 substituting '1.0' for '0.50'. Its section 49 amends the Marriage Registration Ordinance and is nothing to do with this statute. No tree was built: parsing the whole Finance Act as a Registration of Documents amendment would misfile it.

statute_note: Verification: unverified. PRINCIPAL STATUTE: one edition is finalized, the LankaLaw consolidated HTML (lankalaw.net/.../2001Y5V117C.html), a private republisher and not the Government Printer. It yields 50 sections under 5 crossheadings and 7 subheadings, 96 subsections, 25 paragraphs, 13 subparagraphs, 46 cross-references, and references to 2 schedules whose bodies the page does not print. The amendment chain printed in its header runs to Act No. 5 of 1990, so the principal text predates Acts No. 48 of 2011, No. 21 of 2013, No. 32 of 2022 and No. 18 of 2024. Those four now have trees of their own here, but the principal tree has not been rebuilt from them and does not read as amended by them. Two provisions are known stale for the same reason and are not marked as such in the principal tree: section 12, repealed by section 85(1) of the Partition Act No. 16 of 1951, and Part III of the First Schedule, amended by section 51 of the Finance Act No. 11 of 1963. AMENDING INSTRUMENTS: eleven of the nineteen in the chain are parsed into trees, at three levels of confidence. (1) Read from a publisher's HTML: Acts No. 27 of 1969, No. 50 of 1982 and No. 5 of 1990, and Laws No. 4 of 1974, No. 14 of 1974 and No. 19 of 1976, all LankaLaw. (2) Read from the Government Printer PDF's own text layer, every word accounted for by scripts/check_parse_coverage.py at 0.00 per cent unmatched: Acts No. 48 of 2011, No. 21 of 2013 and No. 18 of 2024. Act No. 21 of 2013 carries a structural defect -- its section 5, which amends the First Schedule, is not a separate node and sits inside section 4, because that page runs its marginal note down the left column. (3) Read from an offline OCR of a scan, wording not proof-read: Acts No. 22 of 1958 and No. 32 of 2022. The OCR sidecar and the scan it was read from are both carried here. Act No. 32 of 2022 is the least reliable tree in the package and should not be relied on before proof-reading: its section headings have absorbed runs of body text and its Second Schedule forms are read as duplicate sections. Every OCR and layout defect found is recorded per instrument in data/processed/amendment-overrides.json under known_ocr_defects and quality_notes. HELD BUT NOT PARSED: two general Acts, each carrying a single provision that amends this Ordinance -- the Partition Act No. 16 of 1951, section 85(1), and the Finance Act No. 11 of 1963, section 51. Both are image scans; both have been OCR'd and the sidecars are carried here alongside the scans, with the amending provision identified in this manifest. No tree was built for either, because a tree of the whole Partition Act or the whole Finance Act filed as a Registration of Documents amendment would misfile it. Building those two properly means giving each its own source_id as a principal Act. NOT HELD: six instruments in the chain are in no archive we hold -- Ordinances No. 19 of 1928, No. 22 of 1930, No. 14 of 1936, No. 34 of 1939 and No. 13 of 1947, and Act No. 6 of 1949. NAME COLLISION: data/legal-sources/library/amendments/html/11-1963-marriage-registration-amendment.html is a different Act No. 11 of 1963, amending the Marriage Registration Ordinance, and is not part of this package. BUILD NOTE: the PDF-backed trees must be built from PowerShell. Git Bash resolves pdftotext to an Xpdf 4.00 build that ignores -enc UTF-8; built that way, Act No. 21 of 2013 lost three sections and every curly quote became U+FFFD, with nothing in the tree saying so. The scanned PDF of the principal Ordinance at data/legal-sources/library/statutes/23-1927-registration-of-documents-ordinance.pdf was not parsed and was not read to check this tree, so it is not carried here. Nothing in the section index has been updated from any of these trees yet.
